title: Some annoying bugs
content: Portifolio graphic does not reflect the manually inserted transactions if the date was before current date. Profile completion did not give the 10 diamonds as advertised. The acclaimed “better historical graph” rolls left or right instead to show the values where we touch the graph: you only can see the past values when the graph is far left (limited by the graph’s left border) Please, correct those bugs! A nice addiction is add a way to sort the “coin watch list” as the user decides instead of only by market cap position.
